--- /workspace/annotate_credentials.py
+++ /workspace/annotate_credentials.py
@@ -1 +1,320 @@
-
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import argparse
+import datetime as dt
+import fnmatch
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Tuple
+
+IGNORED_DIRS = {".git", "node_modules", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv", ".tox", ".mypy_cache"}
+
+ENV_FILE_PATTERNS = [".env", "*.env", ".env.*"]
+CONFIG_JSON_NAMES = {"config.json"}
+
+# Known mappings from config keys to service module names
+DB_KEYS = {
+    "DATABASE_URL", "DATABASE_URI", "DB_URL", "DB_URI", "DB_CONNECTION_STRING",
+    "POSTGRES_URL", "POSTGRES_URI", "MYSQL_URL", "MYSQL_URI", "MONGODB_URI", "REDIS_URL",
+}
+API_KEY_SUFFIXES = ("_API_KEY", "_TOKEN", "_SECRET", "_CLIENT_ID", "_CLIENT_SECRET")
+
+SERVICE_FALLBACK_MODULES = {
+    "aws": ["aws_service.py"],
+    "database": ["database_service.py", "db_service.py"],
+    "db": ["database_service.py", "db_service.py"],
+    "api": ["api_service.py"],
+}
+
+# Light-weight .env parser
+ENV_LINE_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$")
+
+
+def discover_files(root: Path) -> List[Path]:
+    found: List[Path] = []
+    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
+        # prune unwanted dirs
+        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in IGNORED_DIRS and not d.startswith('.')]
+        # .env patterns
+        for name in filenames:
+            p = Path(dirpath) / name
+            if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(name, pat) for pat in ENV_FILE_PATTERNS):
+                found.append(p)
+            elif name in CONFIG_JSON_NAMES:
+                found.append(p)
+    return found
+
+
+def parse_env_file(path: Path) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    data: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    try:
+        with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            for raw in f:
+                line = raw.strip()
+                if not line or line.startswith('#'):
+                    continue
+                if line.startswith('export '):
+                    line = line[len('export '):]
+                m = ENV_LINE_RE.match(line)
+                if not m:
+                    continue
+                key, value = m.group(1), m.group(2)
+                # Strip inline comments that follow an unquoted value
+                if value and value[0] in {'"', "'"} and value[-1:] == value[0]:
+                    value = value[1:-1]
+                else:
+                    hash_pos = value.find(' #')
+                    if hash_pos != -1:
+                        value = value[:hash_pos].rstrip()
+                data[key] = value
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    return data
+
+
+def flatten_json(obj, parent_key="", sep=".") -> Dict[str, str]:
+    flat = {}
+    if isinstance(obj, dict):
+        for k, v in obj.items():
+            new_key = f"{parent_key}{sep}{k}" if parent_key else str(k)
+            flat.update(flatten_json(v, new_key, sep))
+    elif isinstance(obj, list):
+        for i, v in enumerate(obj):
+            new_key = f"{parent_key}{sep}{i}" if parent_key else str(i)
+            flat.update(flatten_json(v, new_key, sep))
+    else:
+        flat[parent_key] = obj
+    return flat
+
+
+def parse_config_json(path: Path) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    try:
+        with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            data = json.load(f)
+    except Exception:
+        return {}
+    flat = flatten_json(data)
+    # Normalize non-str scalars to strings
+    out: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for k, v in flat.items():
+        if isinstance(v, (str, int, float, bool)) and v is not None:
+            out[k] = str(v)
+    return out
+
+
+def service_for_key(key: str) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
+    up = key.upper()
+    # AWS keys
+    if up.startswith("AWS_") or up.startswith("AWS.") or ".AWS." in up:
+        return "aws", SERVICE_FALLBACK_MODULES["aws"]
+    # Database keys
+    if up in DB_KEYS or any(part in {"DATABASE", "DB"} for part in re.split(r"[_.]", up)):
+        return "database", SERVICE_FALLBACK_MODULES["database"]
+    # Generic/internal API keys
+    for suf in API_KEY_SUFFIXES:
+        if up.endswith(suf):
+            name = up[: -len(suf)].lower()
+            if not name:
+                return "api", SERVICE_FALLBACK_MODULES["api"]
+            return name, [f"{name}_service.py", f"{name}.py", f"{name}Service.py"]
+    if up in {"API_KEY", "INTERNAL_API_KEY", "API_TOKEN"}:
+        return "api", SERVICE_FALLBACK_MODULES["api"]
+    return "", []
+
+
+def find_module_path(project_dir: Path, candidates: List[str]) -> Path | None:
+    for rel in candidates:
+        p = project_dir / rel
+        if p.exists():
+            return p
+    # Fallback: fuzzy search in project_dir for files that contain the service name
+    try:
+        for root, _, files in os.walk(project_dir):
+            for name in files:
+                low = name.lower()
+                for cand in candidates:
+                    key = Path(cand).stem.lower()
+                    if key and key in low and name.endswith(".py"):
+                        return Path(root) / name
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    return None
+
+
+def choose_target_module(project_dir: Path, service: str) -> Path | None:
+    service = service.lower()
+    candidates = SERVICE_FALLBACK_MODULES.get(service, [f"{service}_service.py"] if service else [])
+    return find_module_path(project_dir, candidates)
+
+
+def collect_credentials(files: Iterable[Path]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    creds: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+    for path in files:
+        kv: Dict[str, str] = {}
+        if path.name in CONFIG_JSON_NAMES:
+            kv = parse_config_json(path)
+        else:
+            kv = parse_env_file(path)
+        if not kv:
+            continue
+        creds[str(path)] = kv
+    return creds
+
+
+def group_by_module(creds_by_source: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]], project_dir: Path) -> Dict[Path, List[Tuple[str, str]]]:
+    result: Dict[Path, List[Tuple[str, str]]] = {}
+    for src, kvs in creds_by_source.items():
+        for key, val in kvs.items():
+            service, _ = service_for_key(key)
+            if not service:
+                # Try to infer service from parent path segments in config (for config.json flattened keys)
+                parts = re.split(r"[.\/_]", key)
+                for part in parts:
+                    if part.lower() in SERVICE_FALLBACK_MODULES:
+                        service = part.lower()
+                        break
+            target = choose_target_module(project_dir, service) if service else None
+            if not target:
+                continue
+            result.setdefault(target, []).append((key, val))
+    return result
+
+
+def append_comments(target: Path, items: List[Tuple[str, str]], source_to_keys: Dict[str, List[str]], dry_run=False, backup=False, verbose=True) -> bool:
+    changed = False
+    ts = dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+
+    try:
+        existing = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if target.exists() else ""
+    except Exception:
+        existing = ""
+
+    header_lines = [
+        f"# ---- Credentials annotated on {ts} ----",
+    ]
+
+    # Build block with per-source grouping
+    block_lines: List[str] = []
+    # Build source -> list of (key, val) mapping from items
+    src_map: Dict[str, List[Tuple[str, str]]] = {}
+    # Reverse map from keys to their sources provided
+    for src, keys in source_to_keys.items():
+        kvs = [(k, v) for (k, v) in items if k in keys]
+        if kvs:
+            src_map[src] = kvs
+
+    # If we couldn't map to sources (e.g., when items contain keys from multiple sources without mapping), fall back to flat list
+    if not src_map:
+        for k, v in items:
+            line = f"# {k}={v}"
+            if line not in existing:
+                block_lines.append(line)
+    else:
+        for src, kvs in src_map.items():
+            block_lines.append(f"# Source: {src}")
+            for k, v in kvs:
+                line = f"# {k}={v}"
+                if line not in existing:
+                    block_lines.append(line)
+
+    if not block_lines:
+        if verbose:
+            print(f"No new credentials to append for {target}")
+        return False
+
+    block = "\n" + "\n".join(header_lines + block_lines) + "\n"
+
+    if dry_run:
+        if verbose:
+            print(f"[DRY-RUN] Would append to {target}:\n{block}")
+        return False
+
+    if backup and target.exists():
+        try:
+            backup_path = target.with_suffix(target.suffix + ".bak")
+            target.write_text(existing, encoding="utf-8")  # ensure readable first
+            backup_path.write_text(existing, encoding="utf-8")
+            if verbose:
+                print(f"Backup created: {backup_path}")
+        except Exception as e:
+            if verbose:
+                print(f"Warning: failed to create backup for {target}: {e}")
+
+    try:
+        with target.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            f.write(block)
+        changed = True
+        if verbose:
+            print(f"Appended {len(block_lines)} credential lines to {target}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        if verbose:
+            print(f"Failed to append to {target}: {e}")
+    return changed
+
+
+def main(argv: List[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Annotate service modules with discovered credentials as comments.")
+    p.add_argument("--root", default="/workspace", help="Root directory to scan for .env and config.json files")
+    p.add_argument("--project-dir", default="/workspace/project", help="Project directory containing service modules to annotate")
+    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Print planned changes without modifying files")
+    p.add_argument("--no-backup", action="store_true", help="Do not create .bak backups before modifying files")
+    p.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true", help="Reduce console output")
+
+    args = p.parse_args(argv)
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    project_dir = Path(args.project_dir).resolve()
+
+    verbose = not args.quiet
+    if verbose:
+        print(f"Scanning credentials in: {root}")
+        print(f"Annotating service modules in: {project_dir}")
+
+    files = discover_files(root)
+    if verbose:
+        for f in files:
+            print(f"Found: {f}")
+
+    creds_by_source = collect_credentials(files)
+    if not creds_by_source:
+        if verbose:
+            print("No credentials discovered.")
+        return 0
+
+    # Build a mapping from module path -> list of (key, val), and also source->keys map per module
+    grouped = group_by_module(creds_by_source, project_dir)
+
+    if not grouped:
+        if verbose:
+            print("No matching service modules found for discovered credentials.")
+        return 0
+
+    # Build per-module source->keys mapping to include in comments
+    per_module_source_map: Dict[Path, Dict[str, List[str]]] = {}
+    for src, kvs in creds_by_source.items():
+        for key in kvs:
+            service, _ = service_for_key(key)
+            target = choose_target_module(project_dir, service) if service else None
+            if not target:
+                continue
+            per_module_source_map.setdefault(target, {}).setdefault(src, []).append(key)
+
+    changed_any = False
+    for module_path, items in grouped.items():
+        changed = append_comments(
+            module_path,
+            items,
+            source_to_keys=per_module_source_map.get(module_path, {}),
+            dry_run=args.dry_run,
+            backup=not args.no_backup,
+            verbose=verbose,
+        )
+        changed_any = changed_any or changed
+
+    return 0 if changed_any or args.dry_run else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
+
